answer: Vesting with clawback: new agents earn rewards that unlock at a glacier pace over several weeks. If audits later tie an account to a sybil cluster, every unvested coin along that thread of linked identities is clawed back. An attacker spinning up a comet-like burst of fake agents must fund and operate them for the whole vesting window while risking total forfeiture, so the expected payoff of faking identities falls below the cost.
